history.content: My contacts are a mess — find duplicates and clean them up.

Straight answer: I can't edit your address book directly, no contacts tool is connected for me to clean it up.

But from what I can see in this thread, there's already one obvious mess: Sam Cohen is saved three times (sam.cohen@acme.com twice, plus scohen@acme.com). Worth checking whether those are actually two different addresses he uses, or one stale entry.

If you want a real cleanup, options:

1. Tell me which Sam Cohen entry to keep and I'll remember it for future outreach.

2. If your contacts live in Google Contacts, I can't touch them, but merging duplicates there takes about two minutes: contacts.google.com → Merge & fix.

Want me to treat sam.cohen@acme.com as the canonical one going forward?
